traditions.LXX: Τῷ Δαυείδ .
traditions.KJV: [ A Psalm ] of David .

1.english_reference: I will praise thee with my whole heart

traditions.WLC: אוֹדְ ךָ֥ בְ כָל לִבִּ֑ י
traditions.LXX: Ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι , Κύριε , ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου ,
traditions.VUL: Confitébor tibi Dómine in toto corde meo :
traditions.KJV: I will praise thee with my whole heart :

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἤκουσας τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου ·

1.english_reference: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐναντίον ἀγγέλων ψαλῶ σοι .
traditions.KJV: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee .

2.english_reference: I will worship toward thy holy temple

traditions.LXX: προσκυνήσω πρὸς ναὸν ἅγιόν σου ,
traditions.KJV: I will worship toward thy holy temple ,

2.english_reference: and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth

traditions.WLC: וְ א֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת שְׁמֶ֗ ךָ עַל חַסְדְּ ךָ֥ וְ עַל אֲמִתֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξομολογήσομαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου καὶ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου ,
traditions.VUL: et confitébor nómini tuo , super misericórdia tua et veritáte tua :
traditions.KJV: and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth :
traditions.DSS: ו אודה את שמ׳כה על חסד׳כה ו על אמת׳כה

2.english_reference: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל כָּל שִׁ֝מְ ךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνας ἐπὶ πᾶν ὄνομα τὸ ἅγιόν σου .
traditions.VUL: quóniam magnificásti super omne , nomen sanctum tuum .
traditions.KJV: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name .
traditions.DSS: כי הגדלתה על כול שמ׳כה אמרת׳כה

3.english_reference: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me

traditions.WLC: בְּ י֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽ תַּעֲנֵ֑ נִי
traditions.LXX: ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλέσωμαι , ταχὺ ἐπάκουσόν μου ·
traditions.VUL: In quacúmque die invocávero te , exáudi me :
traditions.KJV: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me , [ and ]

3.english_reference: strengthenedst me strength in my soul

traditions.WLC: תַּרְהִבֵ֖ נִי בְ נַפְשִׁ֣ י עֹֽז
traditions.LXX: πολυωρήσεις με ἐν ψυχῇ μου ἐν δυνάμει πολλῇ .
traditions.KJV: strengthenedst me [ with ] strength in my soul .

4.english_reference: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee , O LORD

traditions.WLC: יוֹד֣וּ ךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל מַלְכֵי אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι , Κύριε , πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς ,
traditions.VUL: Confiteántur tibi Dómine omnes reges terræ :
traditions.KJV: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee , O LORD ,

4.english_reference: when they hear the words of thy mouth

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἤκουσαν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός σου ·
traditions.VUL: quia audiérunt ómnia verba oris tui .
traditions.KJV: when they hear the words of thy mouth .

5.english_reference: Yea , they shall sing in the ways of the LORD

traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾀσάτωσαν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς Κυρίου ,
traditions.KJV: Yea , they shall sing in the ways of the LORD :

5.english_reference: for great [ is ] the glory of the LORD

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἡ δόξα Κυρίου μεγάλη ·
traditions.KJV: for great [ is ] the glory of the LORD .

6.english_reference: Though the LORD [ be ] high , yet hath he respect unto the lowly

traditions.WLC: כִּי רָ֣ם יְ֭הוָה וְ שָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὑψηλὸς Κύριος , καὶ τὰ ταπεινὰ ἐφορᾷ ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam excélsus Dóminus , et humília réspicit :
traditions.KJV: Though the LORD [ be ] high , yet hath he respect unto the lowly :
traditions.DSS: כי רם יהוה ו שפל יראה

6.english_reference: but the proud he knoweth afar off

traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν γινώσκει .
traditions.KJV: but the proud he knoweth afar off .

7.english_reference: Though I walk in the midst of trouble , thou wilt revive me

traditions.WLC: אִם אֵלֵ֤ךְ בְּ קֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥ נִי
traditions.LXX: ἐὰν πορευθῶ ἐν μέσῳ θλίψεως , ζήσεις με ·
traditions.VUL: Si ambulávero in médio tribulatiónis , vivificábis me :
traditions.KJV: Though I walk in the midst of trouble , thou wilt revive me :
traditions.DSS: אם אלך ב תוך צרה תחי׳ני

7.english_reference: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies

traditions.WLC: עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַ י תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἐπ᾽ ὀργὴν ἐχθρῶν ἐξέτεινας χεῖράς μου ,
traditions.VUL: et super iram inimicórum meórum extendísti manum tuam ,
traditions.KJV: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies ,

7.english_reference: and thy right hand shall save me

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσωσέν με ἡ δεξιά σου .
traditions.VUL: et salvum me fecit déxtera tua .
traditions.KJV: and thy right hand shall save me .

8.english_reference: The LORD will perfect [ that which ] concerneth me

traditions.LXX: Κύριε , ἀνταποδώσεις ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ ·
traditions.KJV: The LORD will perfect [ that which ] concerneth me :

8.english_reference: thy mercy , O LORD , [ endureth ] for ever

traditions.LXX: Κύριε , τὸ ἔλεός σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ,
traditions.KJV: thy mercy , O LORD , [ endureth ] for ever :

8.english_reference: forsake not the works of thine own hands

traditions.LXX: Κύριε , τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου μὴ παρῇς .
traditions.KJV: forsake not the works of thine own hands .
